//buildCommand: Must go through Turbo. `next build` alone fails on a clean checkout with 'Module not found: @adsight/ui' — the shared packages resolve to dist/, which does not exist until they are compiled. The cd is because Vercel runs this from the Root Directory (apps/web), while the Turbo workspace is at the repo root.
//installCommand: Run from the repo root so npm installs the whole workspace, not just apps/web.
//outputDirectory: Relative to the Root Directory, which is where Turbo writes it.
//env: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL is NOT set here on purpose. It is inlined at build time, so it must be a real value from the Vercel dashboard (Production and Preview both) — hardcoding a placeholder here would ship a client that calls the wrong host.
